设计意图： Mutation of factor_drawdown_stress_vol_scaled. Shortens drawdown detection window to 40 days and occupancy window to 10 days, making the signal more responsive to recent stress. Doubles the volatility attenuation coefficient to emphasize low-volatility regimes, which are more conducive to mean reversion. Targets improvement in IC and RankIC while preserving the positive payoff mechanism.

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 rolling_max：close.滚动窗口(40, min_periods=40).max()
  3. 计算 in_drawdown：close < rolling_max * 0.95
  4. 计算 occupancy：in_drawdown.滚动窗口(10, min_periods=10).sum() / 10.0
  5. 计算 depth：(close / rolling_max) - 1.0
  6. 计算 stress：-depth * occupancy
  7. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  8. 计算 vol：ret.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1)
  9. 计算 vol_attenuation：1.0 / (1.0 + 2.0 * vol)
  10. 计算 stress_scaled：stress * vol_attenuation
  11. 计算 stress_scaled：stress_scaled
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_stress_vol_scaled_v2(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] rolling_max = close.rolling(40, min_periods=40).max() in_drawdown = close < rolling_max * 0.95 occupancy = in_drawdown.rolling(10, min_periods=10).sum() / 10.0 depth = (close / rolling_max) - 1.0 stress = -depth * occupancy ret = close.pct_change() vol = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1).replace(0.0, np.nan) vol_attenuation = 1.0 / (1.0 + 2.0 * vol) stress_scaled = stress * vol_attenuation stress_scaled = stress_scaled.fillna(0.0) df_copy["factor_drawdown_stress_vol_scaled_v2"] = stress_scaled "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_drawdown_stress_vol_scaled_v2"]
